paragraphs: 580,432 visits a month, and 30.7% of them are bought through paid search and display.
3.18 pages and 2:04 a visit. People arrive with a date and a theme in mind and go looking for the pieces. How many of those sessions end in a cart, we cannot see from outside.

ideas.head: Theme first discovery
ideas.hypothesis: Visitors who arrive with a party theme buy more when every piece of that theme sits on one page.
ideas.change: Theme pages that bundle costume, decoration and tableware, linked from the homepage and search.
ideas.metric: Revenue per visitor against a live control.

ideas.head: Paid traffic landing pages
ideas.hypothesis: A bought visit converts better when the page matches the search it came from.
ideas.change: Landing pages matched to the main paid search themes instead of the generic category page.
ideas.metric: Conversion rate of paid sessions against a live control.
